scenicChapters.title: Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 19 km this is Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

story: 71 km from Lisiy Nos to Lisiy Nos, about 1 h 13 of riding. On the way it passes Fort «Totleben», Fort «Peter I» and back through Fort «Totleben». The line favours views over speed.
